title: OWNED: Product & Engineering Leadership Under Investors
prompt: Create a polished editorial header illustration for a journal about product and engineering leadership under investors. Match the article-header illustrations: crisp navy outlines, clean flat cartoon forms, warm ivory background, muted teal, blue and warm ochre accents, minimal shading, generous space. Use one connected visual metaphor with oversized useful objects and two small human figures. In the center, two company leaders work together at a broad open planning notebook that supports a miniature software company: one leader arranges a few product cards and the other connects simple engineering blocks. To the left, a modest stack of coins, a plain funding agreement and a key represent investor resources and decision rights. To the right, a working product screen and two small customer silhouettes represent the work the company must sustain. A gently curved path connects the resources, company work and customers without looking like a quantitative chart. Keep the company leaders active and responsible for the work. Draw exactly two arms per visible person and keep props distinct. Landscape 16:9; place the main scene in the central horizontal band, with plenty of ivory margin above and below for a wide journal header. This should look like the journal's illustrated article headers, with a pictorial business-and-technology scene. NO wordmark, corporate identity symbol, abstract brand mark, monogram, letter O, book title, letters, labels, numbers, tiny text, company brands, photorealism, screenshot, decorative border, dense process map or 3D rendering. No giant growth chart or claim that funding guarantees success.

revisions.reason: The author requested the same illustrated style as the article logos, rather than a company-style wordmark.
revisions.previous_prompt: Create a finished editorial journal logo for a book named OWNED, about product and engineering leadership under investors. A restrained, memorable horizontal logo lockup, not a scene or explanatory diagram. On the left, create a bold architectural O emblem assembled from three carefully fitted geometric blocks around a clean open ivory center. Use mostly deep navy, with one muted teal block and one small warm ochre accent. The joined but distinct parts suggest ownership boundaries, company capability and support. On the right, the exact word OWNED in large, confident, beautifully spaced uppercase editorial serif lettering. Print OWNED exactly once. Warm ivory background, crisp flat shapes, exceptionally clear silhouette, premium book-publisher identity, balanced proportions, no texture or gradients. Landscape 16:9 canvas. Keep the ENTIRE horizontal emblem and wordmark together inside the central 70 percent of the canvas width and central 45 percent of its height, with generous empty margins above and below so the header can crop vertically. No subtitle, slogan, initials, other words, currency symbols, growth arrows, charts, gears, people, buildings, fine details, border, watermark, mockup, paper photograph or 3D effects. The final image is the logo itself.

alt: Company leaders connect investor funding and decision rights to product, engineering and customer work.
rendition_note: The current source rendition was visually reviewed after an in-place image revision.
